snippet.title: Game Gear Longplay [033] Sonic Blast
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Mad-Matt

The last sonic game and probably one of the last games made for the Game Gear in 1996.

Graphically it looks as near as you can get to its 16bit counterpart on an 8bit handheld. The levels are quite small however so not to hard to memorize the various routes. Still, some of the bonus rings are in tricky to reach places. On each boss stage there is a button to find that allows access to a ring room. I tried to show these but sometimes forgot. Again I spend to much time collecting rings, but this is just how I play ..... Grin -
